arabic text: HAR DARD KA MANZAR HE, SAJJAD KI AANKHON ME
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nEVERY SCENE AND ITS PAIN, REMAINS IN SAJJAD’S SIGHT

arabic text: ZAINAB KA KHULA SAR HE, SAJJAD KI AANKHON ME
english translation text: ZAINAB’S HEAD HIJAB, REMAINS IN SAJJAD’S SIGHT\nTHE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS

arabic text: ATHARA BARAS PAALA MAANE JISE PARDE ME\nBARCHI KI ANI TOOTI USS CHAAND KE SINE ME
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nFOR 18 YEARS WHOM SHE BROUGHT UP\nIN THE CHEST OF THAT MOON, THE TIP OF THE SPEAR LIES BROKEN

arabic text: WO LAASHA-E-AKBAR HE, SAJJAD KI AANKHON ME
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nTHAT BODY OF AKBAR, REMAINS IN SAJJAD’S SIGHT

arabic text: JAB TAK BHI RAHI ZINDAAN, SAAYE ME NAHI BHETI\nBAS YAAD ME ASGHAR KE KHOYI HUWI REHTI THI
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nTHE REST OF HER DAYS, SHE DIDN’T SIT IN A SHADE\nIN THE REMEMBRANCE OF ASGHAR, SHE WAS LOST IN THOUGHTS

arabic text: BESHEER KI YAADE HEN, SAJJAD KI AANKHON ME
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nTHE INFANTS MEMORY, REMAINS IN SAJJAD’S SIGHT

arabic text: JIS KE LIYE BACHPAN ME, JANNAT SE LIBAAS AAYE\nWO DIL BARE ZAHRA HE BE-GORO KAFAN HAAYE
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nTHE ONE IN WHOSE CHILDHOOD, CLOTHES WERE SENT FROM PARADISE\nHE WHO WAS ZAHRA’S HEART-BEAT, LIES WITHOUT KAFAN OR BURIAL

arabic text: MAZLUMII YE SARWAR HE, SAJJAD KI AANKHON ME
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nTHE OPPRESSED CHIEF (AND HIS LONELINESS), REMAINS IN SAJJAD’S SIGHT

arabic text: BE PARDA JO GUZRI HE BAZAAR KE RASTE SE\nBE JURM KHATA JIS PAR PATHAR BHI BARASTE THE
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nWITHOUT HIJAB, IN THE STREETS THEY WERE PARADED\nWITHOUT ANY FAULT OR MISTAKE, WITH STONES THEY WERE PELTED

arabic text: WO AALE PAYAMBAR HE, SAJJAD KI AANKHON ME
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nTHIS SCENE, OF THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET, REMAINS IN SAJJAD’S SIGHT

arabic text: KIS TARHA SE CHARHAYA, BE ZEEN SAWARI PE\nGIRTE THE SAMBHAL TE THE, BACHE WO YE UNTO SE
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nTHEY WERE MADE TO SIT ON CAMELS WITHOUT SADDLES\nCHILDREN WOULD FALL ONTO THE GROUND FROM THE TOP OF THE CAMELS

arabic text: RASTE KI WO MUSHKIL HE, SAJJAD KI AANKHON ME
english translation text: THE TRIALS OF IMAM SAJJAD AS\nTHE DIFFICULTIES OF THE JOURNEY, REMAINS IN SAJJAD’S SIGHT
